entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for an order. Just need a yes or no on if I can send it back.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sarah Miller, order is VF88602. Can I return the VeloBand or not?

Okay, one moment, Sarah... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 17th. To make sure I'm handling this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not a fault. The box is unopened. Look, we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband required an unexpected surgery, and the whole situation has been a nightmare. I've basically been living at the hospital.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay.
It's just a lot, especially with his deployment coming up. I just need to know if I can return this. I don't have time to go back and forth.

I completely understand, Sarah. No need to worry. Let me just confirm the policy for you... Okay, yes. You are well within the 90-day return window for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. Okay, good. What do I do next?

I have just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account. You can print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Alright, I see the email. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Sarah. I wish your husband a swift recovery. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
